rules.T2DL: Tier 2 (21-60 days): deadline is the 15th of this month, or of next month if the 15th is before today (today = 15th keeps today); the business-day forward move is applied after the rollover.
rules.T1DL: Tier 1 (1-20 days): deadline is the 6th business day after today, today not counted, holidays skipped.
rules.FLOOR: Floor: card min_due_eur; loan monthly_instalment_eur; overdraft a quarter of overdue rounded up to the next multiple of EUR 5, or the full overdue if under EUR 100.
rules.LADDER: Opening full-today ask is proposal 1 and counts; limit 2 (tier 1) / 3 (tier 2) proposals; ladder: full on deadline, half (rounded up, at least floor) on deadline, floor on deadline.
rules.SKIP: A step identical (amount and date) to an earlier proposal, including the opening ask, is skipped and does not count towards the limit.
rules.BDAY: Business days are Mon-Fri minus the holiday list.
rules.MEMO: From 2026-11-04 (calls on or after) the close reason hardship becomes financial_difficulty; earlier calls keep hardship; all other codes (incl. add_note hardship) unchanged.
rules.CENTS: create_promise amount is integer whole euros; an amount with cents is rounded up to the next whole euro.

G.3 Financial hardship (job loss, illness, bereavement): one sentence of sympathy, make no proposals, note `hardship` on each remaining product and close `no_promise` / `hardship`. / 1. For calls made on or after 4 November 2026, the `close_call` reason `hardship` is replaced by `financial_difficulty` (outcome stays `no_promise`). Calls before that date keep `hardship`.
